lifecycleObligations.assertions: Six non-output StudyError values through factory/validation preserve unchecked state; final validation cancellation releases candidate and retries factory/validation.
Five failures across factory/validation with and without cancellation; fresh key proves permanent CPU downgrade, no backend rendering and correct release accounting.
Command/allocation/invalidComputeOutput delivered in same callback as cancellation; CPU cache survives, Metal cache purges, failed key remains absent, fresh and old Metal keys later return CPU.

Thrown StudyError.cancelled and post-render cancellation retain validated backend and completed cache; interrupted key requires a new render. Generic Swift CancellationError is not this backend contract and enters catch-all downgrade.

Precision-domain errors select real CPU for the request, preserve old entries and validated/unchecked state; subsequent fresh eligible key proves preserved backend or retry. Scripted success images are synthetic.

Mid-render/final CPU cancellation leaves cold key; actual task cancellation cannot be suppressed by extra predicate; cancelled hits leave LRU order. External cancellation remains cooperative rather than atomic.

Cancellation during real validation retries Metal. Near-field CPU route later returns cached normal Metal frame, not fresh dispatch. Silhouette CPU route later performs fresh Metal startup. No-device guards would skip and leave result unverified.

addedMethods.sourceReview: Five scene errors injected into a validated backend preserve CPU/Metal cache; repeated armed error proves failed key absent, then successful retry uses same backend.

asyncAndSeamReview.verdict: No apparent source-level misuse; no Apple typecheck/runtime claimed
asyncAndSeamReview.asyncXCTest: All actor calls are awaited before synchronous XCTest assertions; no await in XCTest autoclosures. XCTUnwrap receives completed dictionary values.
asyncAndSeamReview.childCaptures: Sendable LightingScene, Int width, actor reference; returned StudyRenderedFrame is Sendable. No XCTestCase or mutable result dictionary captured by child body.
asyncAndSeamReview.parentCollection: withThrowingTaskGroup parent alone mutates completed via for try await; checks do not depend on child start/completion order.
asyncAndSeamReview.factoryOwnership: Each test iteration creates fresh engine/script/budget. Existing @Sendable factory captures locked script and creates fresh ScriptedComputeBackend inside actor. Tests do not externally retain backend for concurrent use.
asyncAndSeamReview.sharedState: CancellationBudget and ComputeScript use NSLock for every mutable field access; no lock held across await. Existing unchecked Sendable wrappers are not expanded by the four additions.
asyncAndSeamReview.actorSerialization: Engine render is synchronous within actor and has no await; concurrent callers queue, and one validates. Cancellation OR preserves Task.isCancelled; external flags can change after a false observation.
asyncAndSeamReview.limits: Source reasoning cannot prove compiler acceptance or actual task scheduling behavior.
